name: Operation Repo
description: Operation Repo is an American television program that depicts the world of car repossession with a team that portrays fictionalized tales of repossessions from California's San Fernando Valley. Similar to another truTV show, Southern Fried Stings, the series is filmed in a cinema verité style but consists of scripted and dramatized performances by actors. The show is filmed by recreating scenes in which the cast conducts repossessions of automobiles for finance companies. In the show they also perform repossessions of other exotic and strange items such as luxury boats, planes, limousines, motorcycles, ATVs, Zambonis, ice cream trucks, tow trucks, buses, trucks, expensive bicycles, hot air balloons, wood chippers, forklifts, and tanning beds.

videos.title: Facebook Special
videos.overview:
As a result of 500,000 Facebook "likes", the team made a special episode only available on the Facebook website.

Matt gets his butt kicked by female martial arts champion while Luis gets his hands on a Corvette. Sonia and Froy have to repo a car during a wedding.

videos.title: We Are Operation Repo
videos.overview: Meet the team of highly trained San Fernando Valley pros on their first repos involving a gangster and a feisty debtor clinging for life to her car.

videos.title: Don't You Dare Lift-Off
videos.overview: Froy and Matt do a repo and run when the bats and guns start swinging and things heat up for Matt and Sonia before an ambush of a helicopter pilot.

videos.title: Collectibles
videos.overview: A speedboat, truck and trailer are culled from a cul-de-sac, a highly collectible motorcycle is wheeled off and a scrap happens over a forklift.

videos.title: Adult Film Star
videos.overview: The team files charges against a violent debtor, crashes an adult film shoot for a Beamer and gets an assist from a debtor’s sister-in-law.

videos.title: Pizza, Hook-Ups, and a Suspicious Suitcase
videos.overview: The team hits Lovers Lane, a pizza parlor and a car graveyard before facing off against a debtor with a case of the jitters and a bag of cash.

videos.title: Exterminate or Retali
videos.overview: An ambush is set for an exterminator’s truck, debtors are brought to the ground during a backhoe repo and punk kids fight for their four wheelers.

videos.title: Unwanted Seizures
videos.overview: The team repos the Corolla a divorcée won in her settlement and cancels a repo while in hot pursuit and a debtor suffers a seizure during his seizure.

videos.title: Pepper Spray and Guns
videos.overview: Chemical warfare is deployed against an aggressive debtor, a motorcycle seizure ends in a biker battle and guns are drawn during a repo-gone-wrong.

videos.title: Who Wants Ice Cream
videos.overview: It’s the end of the road for a drugged-out debtor, an Infinity meets its end and Lou, Froy and Sonia all scream for an ice cream truck repo.

videos.title: The Cop, the Pizza Delivery Man, and the Repo Men
videos.overview: A pizza delivery driver is left high and dry, the repo of a cop makes a citizen restless and Lou must strike a deal with a fellow repossessor.

videos.title: Hairy Situations
videos.overview: A repo gets hairy outside a wig shop, a family stands its ground and there’s not a dry eye on the team when the repo of a couple ends in pepper spray.

videos.title: Legal Repossession
videos.overview: A canoodling couple is caught by surprise in the back of a car and Lou does a sneak attack to lift the quads of a group of unsuspecting ATV owners.

videos.title: Business Issues
videos.overview: After confronting a hard-headed boss man and the debtor of a taco truck, the team’s repo at a dealership produces a bounty of half a dozen cars.

videos.title: Wrench in the Works
videos.overview: The pace picks up for the team with repos of a plumber, a debtor with a booted car and a tractor from a group of aggressive ranch workers.

videos.title: Hidden Cars and Higher Powers
videos.overview: A helpful gardener helps uncover a hidden car, a preacher protests his repo on the basis of blasphemy and the team runs afoul of law enforcement.

videos.title: Rolling Away
videos.overview: Pushy debtors, obstinate owners and sour stomachs put the team under the gun before staring down its worst repo in company history.

videos.title: Matt's Back
videos.overview: Froy, Mike, Matt, Sonia and Luis repossess cars from a paint-ball range and from a snobby British couple.

videos.title: Burgers, Bottles, and Hustlers
videos.overview: Gun-toting, bottle-breaking gangsta gals, hot-headed fast food workers and a small-time hustler and his feisty crew give the team a heap of trouble.

videos.title: Strapped on the Court
videos.overview: Repos take the team to a basketball court of gun-packing players, a late-night family reunion and some wounded veterans who aren’t what they seem.

videos.title: Role-Players and Blade Swayers
videos.overview: A group of nerdy, role-playing outcasts living in the country lose their Prius and a high-priced Porsche is pried away from a high-rolling doctor.

videos.title: Caught With Their Pants Down
videos.overview: A repo catches Sonia and Froy off-guard, Lou and Lyndah have a run-in with roughnecks at a remote ranch and Froy and Matt find trouble at a pool hall.

videos.title: Honor Rolling Away
videos.overview: An inglorious honor student, a pair of golf club-strapped thugs and a yuppie in a rocky marriage are all forced to part with their coveted cars.

videos.title: Tazed and Amazed
videos.overview: The cops are called in to help Matt and Froy fend off a taser-toting barfly, a bowler drops the ball on his debt and it’s ‘adios’ to an Altima.

videos.title: Intoxicated Marina Idiots
videos.overview: From maritime madness to drug-dealing debtors to the shoe-slinging elite, the San Fernando Valley pros have their repo work cut out for them.

videos.title: Playing the Role
videos.overview: The team goes undercover as happy home buyers, snaps an out-of-work method actor back into reality and goes head-to-head with a company competitor.

videos.title: Broken Bones and Broken Phones
videos.overview: Bodybuilders wrestle for their Jeep Commander, a snoozing stock broker gets a rude awakening and hard lessons are learned in keeping commitments.

videos.title: The Hearse Isn't Empty?
videos.overview: The team clashes with an accountant’s kicky son, crashes a suits-optional pool party and a weeks-long chase ends for a hearse carrying unknown cargo.

videos.title: Froy Gets Beat Up
videos.overview: The Recession hits hard a wealthy couple with a late-model Landcruiser and when dad forgets to pay the bill, a spoiled princess’ Jetta is jettisoned.

videos.title: This Is No Fantasy
videos.overview: A late model sedan turns out to be a bridal mobile repo, Froy loses his cool with fantasy footballers and a fire-raising debtor sets his car ablaze.

videos.title: The Missing RV and the Private Jet
videos.overview: After tracking down an RV that’s been missing in action for three decades, the team finds it’s being used for freewheeling Canadian rock n' rollers.

videos.title: Pyramid Scams and Princesses
videos.overview: Hot-tempered truckers go to the mat for their tractor-trailer, a woman learns she’s been taken for a ride and a nightclub visit nabs a princess.

videos.title: Jet Skis and Massages
videos.overview: A pair of unpaid luxury jet skis becomes a day at the beach, a massage therapist shows off her skills and a dangerous prank is unwittingly pulled.

videos.title: Get That Prowler
videos.overview: A taxi sting comes with drunken collateral, a debtor loses his DeLorean and the team goes on the 'prowl' for a Plymouth in the custody of a man child.

videos.title: Up Up and Away
videos.overview: The team heads for the skies in pursuit of a pair of hot air balloons and the streets against an unintimidated ex-con and a trio of graffiti girls.

videos.title: Family Drama
videos.overview: Team members Lou, Froy and Matt find a repo partner in lending agent Eva who masterminds a sting operation to seize a limousine in default.

videos.title: Kegger and Refrigerator
videos.overview: Belligerent partygoers, an important client’s fragile cargo and an explosive device make for a volatile episode for the San Fernando repo pros.

videos.title: Going Green and Falling Down
videos.overview: A retrofitted repo running on biodiesel surprises Sonia and Froy when they realize its debtor shares some of Sonia's features.

videos.title: Look What You Did!
videos.overview: The team battles over a late-model Tahoe at the bottom of a lake, takes on a taser-toting private eye and the go-jacks go on the wrong repo.

videos.title: That's Disrespectful
videos.overview: The charred remains of a car and a pair of high-flying debtors leaves Sonia and Lyndah wondering if this repo is even worth their trouble.

videos.title: Smoke, Lead, and Alcohol
videos.overview: In one of LA's most dangerous neighborhoods, Matt and Froy face off against a trigger-happy debtor who’s not letting his ride go without a fight.

videos.title: Missed Dates
videos.overview: An inconsolable debtor, unwanted advances, a flirtatious ex, a case of mistaken identities and shotgun-wielding cultists are all in a day’s work.

videos.title: Broken Tooth Lou and Bad Breath Frankie
videos.overview: Lou loses a tooth, Frankie’s breath gives him away and Froy finds himself trapped inside a repo headed for demolition by an unruly construction crew.

videos.overview: A biker's Vespa is reclaimed; the sedan of a children's entertainer in an unusual outfit is repossessed; and six cars are retrieved from a failing dealership.

videos.title: Episode  502

videos.title: Episode 505
videos.overview: A BMW is reclaimed from a gentleman's club patron; a motorcycle is taken back from a unique biker; and a debtor is tracked down on a Native American reservation.

videos.title: Episode 506

videos.title: Episode 507

videos.title: Episode 509

videos.title: Episode 510

videos.title: Episode 511
videos.overview: First, Sonia and Froy repossess an experimental concept motorcycle from a hose-wielding yuppie.

videos.title: Episode 512
videos.overview: First, Sonia and Froy head into a supermarket to repossess a Mitsubishi from a traunt bagboy, but they'll also have to contend with a ferious shopper.

videos.title: Episode 513
videos.overview: Matt and Froy retrieve a car from a cheating husband, Sonia and accident Lyndah a high school reunion to address an over-the-Hill Jock, the team works together to recover a truck loaded with go-karts.

videos.title: Episode 601
videos.overview: First, Matt and Froy must repossess a car from an entitled yuppie, but they'll have to contend with his rampaging long-distance girlfriend. Then, Lou, Lyndah, and Matt venture into a trailer park where they find a debtor who's as angry as he is drunk. Plus, Sonia and Lyndah travel under the cover of night to repossess a vehicle from a young woman and her irate yoga instructor.

videos.title: Episode 602
videos.overview: First, Froy and Sonia trace an out-of-state skip account to a seedy motel, where they come face-to-face with a hopping-mad cowboy and his female companion. Then, Matt and Sonia must repossess a car from a delusional nerd who may as well actually be from space. Plus, a chainsaw-wielding gardener presents a challenge for Lou and Lyndah.

videos.title: Episode 603
videos.overview: First, Sonia and Froy storm a studio to repossess a car from a surly European photographer and his hapless, bikini-clad subjects. Then, Lou and Matt stumble into a lover's quarrel - will they be able to reclaim the vehicle from two suited suitors? And, Lyndah and Sonia wind up getting burned on a repo, literally, when a coffee-wielding waitress goes buck-wild.

And, it's a trip to a parking garage to repossess a stolen limo - with a gaggle of partiers in the back. Will Matt and Sonia be able to hook and book, or will they wind up at each other's throats?

videos.title: Episode 605
videos.overview: First, Matt and Froy interrupt a comedian's preparations for a show to repossess his automobile. Then, Lyndah and Sonia sabotage a paparazzo's big shot by hooking his car. And, Lou and Matt must repo a van from an amateur marching band with a terrible secret.

videos.title: Episode 606
videos.overview: First, Matt and Froy reclaim a vehicle during the debtor's tattooing session. Then, Sonia and Lyndah find themselves in an uncomfortable situation when they barge in on a couple engaging in risqué role-playing. And, Lou and Matt confront a group of irate hockey players during a repo.

videos.title: Episode 607
videos.overview: First, school's out when Sonia and Lyndah try to prematurely end a driving instruction session to repo the student car. Then , Lou, Matt, and Froy bite off way more than they can chew when they intrude upon a shady import/export deal at the docks. And, Lou and Matt are in for the shock of a lifetime when a debtor in a nice neighborhood unleashes some heavy weaponry from the trunk of his car.

Then, Matt and Lou face a dilemma when they realize their target vehicle is filled with angry bees. And, Sonia and Froy hit the airwaves to reclaim a truck that's being used in a radio broadcast stunt.

videos.title: Episode 609
videos.overview: A pool cleaner's truck is taken while he's interacting with wealthy wives; Lou and Froy reclaim a catering van filled with food; and gang members object to their lowrider's seizure.

videos.title: Episode 610
videos.overview: Lou and Froy run into trouble seizing a car in a tough neighborhood; wealthy tennis players lose their smart car; and Matt and Froy are caught on tape while reclaiming a Mercedes from a movie director.

videos.title: Episode 611
videos.overview: The guys go after a car owner with an aggressive boyfriend; a tourist bus with passengers is reclaimed; and a truck used to market an energy drink is seized.

videos.title: Episode 612
videos.overview: Matt and Froy repossess a Porsche in a questionable manner; Matt and Sonia must reclaim a van that is involved in a toxic-material investigation; Matt poses as a valet to repossess a diner's car.

videos.title: Episode 613
videos.overview: Lou and Matt take on a car owner with bodyguards; a car is reclaimed at a yard sale; and a group effort is needed to seize a truckload of ATVs from armed people at the beach.

videos.title: Episode 701
videos.overview: First, Matt and Froy discover that their target car is owned by bat-equipped gang bangers. Then, Sonia, Matt, and Lyndah go undercover as college students to extract an expensive bicycle from an irate athlete. Plus, after the tow truck breaks down on the side of the road, Lou, Matt, and Froy find themselves stuck in the middle of a violent dispute between gun-wielding neighbors.

videos.title: Episode 702
videos.overview: First, Sonia and Lou repossess a car from an irate doctor. Then, a seemingly friendly teacher and an assistant principal nearly come to blows over one of their vehicles. Plus, Lou and Froy retrieve a van from a minister with a terrible secret.

videos.title: Episode 703
videos.overview: First, Lou and Froy pose as a pair of reality TV stars to repossess a dirt bike from a wannabe pro daredevil. Then, Sonia and Matt head to the business district for a different sort of quarry - a high-end luxury tanning bed owned by a less-than-sympathetic German. And, Lou and Matt set up a high-stakes sting operation to bust a shady tow-truck driver, but will their best-laid plans go up in smoke?

videos.title: Episode 704
videos.overview: First, Lou and Froy tail an upper class debtor to a fancy restaurant. Then, Lyndah and Froy repossess a van full of stolen electronics. Plus, Matt and Froy sneak a top-of-the-line dune buggy from a crew of off-roaders.

videos.title: Episode 705
videos.overview: First, Lou and Sonia find themselves in the middle of a baffling marital spat involving a man, his wife, and her untrustworthy yoga instructor. Then, Sonia and Lyndah hit the fashion district to repossess a van from a designer who is behind on her payments. And, Matt and Froy head to a carwash to reclaim a vehicle from a group of vicious, scantily-clad sorority girls.

videos.title: Episode 706
videos.overview: First, Matt and Sonia attempt to repossess a car from a group of cleaver-wielding short-order cooks with a taste for violence. Then, it's trouble in paradise as Matt and Froy take on the task of reclaiming a beach-scene-on-wheels filled with irate supermodels. And, Sonia and Matt find themselves outmatched by a well-armed street gang and its charismatic leader.

videos.title: Episode 707
videos.overview: First, Froy and Sonia repossess a truck from an entitled equestrian who would rather die than let the repo team get their hands on what's in the backseat. Then, Lou and Sonia stumble into the middle of a prolonged business dispute between a flower lady and her displeased client. And, Sonia and Froy hit the links to reclaim a high-end golf cart from a snob who thinks he's too good to pay his bills.

videos.title: Episode 708
videos.overview: First, Lou and Matt inadvertently become pawns in an elaborate and misguided lesson perpetrated by a cheating husband upon his mistress, but the intrigue goes deeper than any other them suspects. Then, Matt and Lou attempt to take a vehicle away from a debtor who is so drunk he doesn't remember agreeing to give his car away voluntarily. And, Froy and Sonia try to take a limousine away from its shotgun-wielding driver and his two suspiciously-dressed passengers.

videos.title: Episode 709
videos.overview: First, Lou and Froy set out some bait in a gated community to attract a security guard who's slow to make his payments, but quick to pull out his pepper spray. Then, Matt and Lou crash a wedding to repo a car from a truant DJ, but will they be able to get away unscathed when the party turns on them? And, Lou and Froy confront a gang of bikers in a back alley. Will the repo team's pleas for patience and calm be enough to overcome the angry bikers' bats and chains?

videos.title: Episode 710
videos.overview: First, Lou and Lyndah reclaim a riding mower from a housewife and her grab-happy husband. Then, Sonia and Matt head out on a scorcher of an afternoon for a repossession. Will they be able to beat both the heat and a pair of geriatric debtors? And, Sonia and Lyndah are left without words when they see the dark and embarrassing secret held in the backseat of a debtor's unpaid vehicle.

videos.title: Episode 711
videos.overview: First, Lou and Lyndah try to negotiate a set of keys away from a raucous group of drunken outdoorsmen. Then, Froy and Lyndah repo a vehicle from a unruly and untalented guitarist. Plus, Froy and Sonia bite off more than they can chew when they try to reclaim an SUV from a confused and embittered former football player.

videos.title: Episode 712
videos.overview: First, Sonia and Lyndah try to repossess a hot tub away from a group of upset partiers. Then, Lou and Matt try to negotiate with a pair of unintelligible and enraged parade participants. And, Lou and Lyndah must repo a car from a group of old men.

videos.title: Episode 713
videos.overview: First, Lyndah and Matt confront a confused debtor who is as quick with his questions as he is with his knife. Then, Lou and Lyndah interrupt a seaside party to repo a motorboat away from a gaggle of misguided youths. And, Lou, Froy, and Sonia head to the dirt track to repossess a car from an event promoter. They seem to be able to reason with him, but his monster truck-driving brother with no respect for human life may prove to be a problem.

videos.title: Hooligans and Explosions
videos.overview: First, Lou and Sonia get back on the job and jump into the deep end with an enraged Scot who won't give up his Mini Cooper.

videos.title: Reading, Painting, and Physical Education
videos.overview: First, Froy and Sonia try to repossess a luxury car from a high-strung librarian. Then, it's some serious sibling rivalry when Matt and Froy retrieve a van from two brothers. Plus, Lou and Matt get knocked for a loop by a sub-professional baseball team who doesn't want to lose their bus.

videos.title: Heavy Hitters
videos.overview: First, it's payback time when Lou, Matt, and Froy stake out the baseball bus that got away - and this time, they've got a foolproof plan. Then, Lou, Matt, and Froy head to a late-night construction site to repossess an enormous crane. And, Sonia and Froy face their worst nightmare when a gang of bikers follows them back to the office.

videos.title: Operation Repo Episode 804
videos.overview: Sonia and Matt have a confrontation with skateboarders; Froy and Sonia try to take a vehicle from a volatile couple; Lou and Froy repossess from wannabe backyard wrestlers.

videos.title: Everybody Just a Child?
videos.overview: First, Matt and Froy get the worst service ever from a street-side coffee vendor who won't give up his truck.

videos.title: Off the Hitch
videos.overview: In this very special episode of Operation Repo, it's the 36 hours that change everything.

videos.title: Matt & Froy Auto Recovery
videos.overview: Sonia and Lou deal with a germaphobe; Froy and Matt must repossess a car from two socialites; and Lyndah and Lou reclaim a fleet of cars from a used-car salesman.

videos.title: Win Some, Quarrelsome, Lose Some
videos.overview: Sonia and Lou repossess a car from an heiress; Froy and Matt attempt to seize a car from a quarreling couple; and a routine job goes wrong for Lyndah, Lou and Rob.

videos.title: We Weren't Informed
videos.overview: Matt and Froy run into a group of illegal immigrants and are attacked by a big man with a big beard. Luis and the team meanwhile are accused of being environmentally unfriendly while repo'ing a biodiesel car.

videos.title: Tijuana Surprise
videos.overview: Matt and Froy get their truck smashed up while Luis and Sonia repo the car of a federal agent. Froy suggests to Matt that they can double their income in Tijuana.

videos.title: Lyndah's Revenge
videos.overview: Luis gets even with Lyndah's attacker from episode 8. Matt and Froy repo the car of a strip club owner in Tijuana

videos.title: El Prisionero
videos.overview: A debtor makes accusations against the Pizarros; a repossession involving a socialite comes with the potential for jail time in Mexico.

videos.title: The Final Showdown
videos.overview: Matt's out for revenge after Froy bails him out of jail in Tijuana; Lou and Sonia must repossess a vehicle from someone close to them.

videos.title: All Tied Up
videos.overview: The team target a warehouse full of cars that need to be seized. Also: a repossession involving a pair of rodeo gals; a confrontation with car thieves.

videos.title: Contact
videos.overview: The team get their stolen truck back; Froy and Lou set out to retrieve a car from fighting brothers-in-law; Matt and Lyndah deal with a tourist at a hostel; and Sonia and Froy go after a car owned by a mysterious man with two wives.

videos.title: The Crush
videos.overview: Lou deals with a hard loss; exotic-sports enthusiasts face losing their truck; drunken revelers don't want to give back their tricked-out bus; and Matt and Lou head to a junkyard to find a debtor.

videos.title: Daddy's Little Girl
videos.overview: The loss of the repo truck could mean the end of the company, but Matt has a possible solution. Elsewhere, Lou and Sonia try to repossess a van from two teens; Froy and Sonia confront an irate baker; Matt and Froy run into trouble during a repo at a truck-racing track.

videos.title: The Junior Partner
videos.overview: Sonia, Lyndah and Froy repossess a wealthy teen's car at a party; Matt and Lyndah deal with a man who thinks he's Uncle Sam; and rowdy rugby players confront Matt and Lou.

videos.title: Hard Turns Ahead
videos.overview: Matt begins to make business decisions; Matt's daughter Ashley helps him deal with two inebriated débutantes; Froy and Sonia reclaim a vintage truck; one of the team members is seriously injured during a Jeep repossession.

videos.title: 15 Minutes of Fame
videos.overview: The confusion over Lou's new business relationship with Matt continues to mount.

videos.title: New Truck Day
videos.overview: The repo team's new truck finally arrives, and with it, a new chapter in the building feud between Team Lou and Team Matt.

videos.title: A Blow to the Head
videos.overview: Froy suffers a serious injury during a routine repo; animosity between Lou and Matt escalates. Later, Sonia and Froy deal with drunken debtors at a roadhouse; Matt and Sonia go to collect a beach bum's trailer; and Froy and Lyndah run into some bad business from a bunch of businessmen who don't want to part with an SUV.

videos.title: Getting in the Axe
videos.overview: Tensions between Lou and Matt continue to boil when Matt enlists his daughter's aid on another job.

videos.title: Burning Up
videos.overview: Lou's new business relationship with Matt starts to unravel when a botched job puts a serious strain on the company.

videos.title: The Rift
videos.overview: A new rift between Matt and the rest of the crew puts the fate of the team in question.

videos.title: The Road to Recovery
videos.overview: Sonia's rehabilitation from her gunshot wound takes a shocking turn. Then, the whole team runs into trouble when they attempt to repossess a carnival ride from a group of wannabes. Plus, Froy and Matt wrangle with a gym owner and his fleet of thugs, and Lou and Sonia repo a truck from a protester in a revealing outfit

videos.title: Monk In The Trunk
videos.overview: Sonia's recovery takes another unexpected turn when she goes too far with a debtor. Sonia and Matt sneak onto a big studio lot to repossess a trailer, but there's a big surprise in store when it turns out Matt and the movie's star have a checkered history, Lou and Sonia interrupt a knitting circle to take a car from a booze-soaked craft enthusiast, and Matt and Froy head out to wine country for a disastrous run-in with a group of debtors who have sworn an oath of silence.

videos.title: Super-Sonia
videos.overview: Things get a lot more complicated for the team when Sonia snaps and puts herself on the business end of a knife and the gangbanger wielding it.

videos.title: Interview With The Repo Man
videos.overview: On this special episode, the repo team confronts their toughest challenge yet: one-on-one interviews with an anger management specialist. Froy and Matt hit the lake to repossess a van from a kayak instructor and his perturbed collection of students, and Lyndah and Froy head to the Hollywood Hills to find a luxury car, but wind up crashing the worst party ever.

videos.title: Disaster at the Derby
videos.overview: Sonia and Lyndah find themselves surrounded by a gang of roller derby girls. Lou and Sonia get lost in translation when they're forced to contend with a pair of Russian movers and their yuppie lawyer clients, and Matt, Lou, and Froy are in a battle of the scams when they try to trick a group of con artists into giving up their vehicle.

videos.title: The Trouble With Tractors
videos.overview: The team's work with the anger management specialist starts to pay off with disastrous consequences. Sonia and Froy drive to the country to repo a tractor and are forced to confront a group of irate corporate hayriders, Lou and Sonia wrangle with a confused lady who is missing both her car and her sense of decency.

videos.title: Welcome Back, Rotter
videos.overview: Matt and Froy interrupt the meeting of a fraternal lodge to ask for a car, but what they get is an angry old man with an angry old rifle, Lou and Sonia set off in search of a vehicle and find themselves interrupting a family celebration for a young veteran with a horrible secret.

videos.title: Crunch Time
videos.overview: Sonia and Froy interrupt an interlude between a debtor and two French maids who are getting surprisingly hands-on with their job, Froy and Matt hit the links to repossess a ball-collector vehicle from a golf course chock full of enraged yuppies.

videos.title: Playing With Fire
videos.overview: Lou and Sonia try to repossess a car from a yuppie with a flair for the arts and for mayhem, Sonia, Matt, and Froy reclaim some unusual equipment from an overgrown hippie with some long hair and a short temper.

videos.title: All The Wrong Moves
